name: night-read-l10-r6
note: E31-AC16 night navigation read, L10 R6: the courier runs 50 m along the authored route. The route band must stay >= 3:1 against the verge (WCAG-style luminance ratio, median over the visible route) and the courier >= 3:1 against the ground. Look for a pale road band between dark verges, readable kerbs/lamps/windows, building silhouettes against the haze, night still dark.
